property_summary: For any access-control contract that grants the caller setLimits, initializing C (through a proxy, since the constructor disables direct initializers) stores that access control, so a subsequent setLimits call succeeds; the mutant stores address(0), whose codeless checkAccess makes every setLimits revert.
change_summary: Replace the access control address argument with address(0) so the stored accessControl is the zero address.
